sources.border_rounds: Largest number of straightening rounds over the per-bone cut of a skin. With none, the cut follows single mesh faces and shows as a saw-tooth edge where one segment's colour meets the next (seen 2026-11-20 at the lower edge of the pelvis on the skinned golfer). Eight rounds were used for the #15150 review clips; the rounds stop sooner when nothing changes. The borders are straighter after them, not straight. 0 switches straightening off.
sources.border_votes: A face takes another label when this many of its three edge neighbours share it. 2 is the smallest majority of three; 3 moves only a face wholly surrounded by one other label. Under 2 no single label would win.
sources.weld_decimals: Vertices equal to this many decimals of a metre (6: one micrometre) count as one when faces are joined into neighbours, so vertices doubled along a texture seam do not make a border.
sources.number_digits: Significant digits of the vertex positions, texture coordinates and bone weights written for each piece; 9 keeps a float32 value exactly.
sources.dropped_material_keys: Attributes left out of each piece's copy of the skin's material. A piece is given one flat colour per frame, and a texture would be multiplied into it.
